title: Baba Vanga talks with souls and entities that are everywhere
summary: Russian Republic tells of Baba Vanga talks with souls and entities that are everywhere, about 1990s at Baba Vanga's yard, Bulgaria, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I asked her, I said, "So, are we alone here?" Or, she even hit me a little and said, "What's wrong with you? Are you stupid or what? Can't you see? It's all around you. There it is. There it is. It's absolutely everywhere.

plain: A man introduced as the president of a Russian republic says that in the 1990s he visited Baba Vanga, a woman in Bulgaria said to speak with souls and unseen beings, in her yard. He says he asked her whether we are alone, and she gave him a little smack and asked if he was stupid, because the beings were all around him, absolutely everywhere. If true, it would mean other beings share our world with us, and we simply fail to notice them.
